name: Mick Staton
desc: Member of the United States House of Representatives, 1981-1983
summary: David Michael Staton, better known as Mick Staton (February 11, 1940 – April 14, 2014) was an American banker and politician. He was a Republican congressman from West Virginia, serving one term in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1981 to 1983.
